name: Xiandai Investment Co.,Ltd
summary: Xiandai Investment Co.,Ltd engages in the construction, operation, maintenance, and management of roads, tunnels, bridges, and ferries in China. It is involved in the investment, development, and operation of real estate; investment and management of hotels; toll collection; construction, charging, and maintenance of highways; car cleaning and parking services; advertising activities; and sale of auto parts, road constructing machinery, construction materials, and metal materials. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Changsha, China.
